title: The batch runner's ready gate is overturned only for PRs that touch different areas (item 902 b)
ruling: Owner picked 902 b on the waiting page (item ready-gate-scope): "Overturn it only for PRs that touch different areas". It overturns the batch runner's ready gate (docs/decisions/session-tiers.md line 114, "marks ready only while no job is queued") only for PRs that touch different areas. Source: the page's save comment (page data, not typed chat); triage did not re-read the answer record. The page answer's own time was 2026-11-16T00:3xZ; the filed time is the save comment's 18:37 CST. Settles the question left open by ruling own-ready-pr-no-queue-wait ("in general", fully or only for unrelated PRs): only for unrelated PRs. What counts as "different areas" is not in the answer; runner 10's proposed definition (its own, not owner-checked) is on step ready-no-queue-wait. A separate rule, own-merge-on-lint-pass ("B for sure", #3562), removes the CI wait itself. Runner 10's tighter measures (18:39 CST Nov 15, relayed by the coordinator; same five PRs #3522, #3545, #3535, #3474, #3514, head files fetched 18:38, 10 pairs; its own, not owner-checked): rule 1 (no shared changed file) 3 of 10 unrelated (#3514 with #3522, #3545, #3535); rule 2 (rule 1 plus no changed test names the other PR's file) 0 of 10, a loose upper bound since merge/test_merge.py and merge/test_lane_lint.py name many repo paths; folder rule 1 of 10. One sample, five PRs, no outcome (conflict or red main) counted. Reading (triage): b frees little today; merge-on-lint-pass (#3562) is what removes the wait.
